name: HelloPrint
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): HelloPrint's 2017 minority investment was made 'via their printing holding Onlineprinters' (Bregal Unternehmerkapital): a position of the Bregal-controlled Onlineprinters group, not of a Project A fund (T2, fund money), and inside the control position excluded as onlineprinters.

name: HomeToGo
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): HomeToGo SE has been listed in Frankfurt since the September 2021 SPAC merger; Project A's position dates to 2025 (live CMS, private_equity) and Florian Heinemann joined the supervisory board in May 2025. A purchase of shares in a listed company is not a venture entry (T3, public-market purchase; decisions.md D3).

name: Modernizing Medicine
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Sale consideration (D2; COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22): the CMS files ModMed under Fund II, 2022, with no entry round because Project A holds it only through ModMed's purchase of Klara (the firm's own post 'Exit: Patient collaboration platform Klara is acquired by ModMed', 2022-02-08). The investment is Klara.

name: Navan
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Sale consideration (D2): the CMS files Navan (formerly TripActions) under Fund II, 2022, with no entry round; Navan bought Project A's Comtravo in 2022, and Project A holds Navan stock only as consideration. The investment is Comtravo.

name: Klein NDOH Acquisitions Fund II, LLC
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): a 2013 New York acquisitions fund with a 'Jack Wang' as executive officer; a fund vehicle, not an operating company (T5), and not Project A's partner (on the team from 2021).

name: Efficient Drivetrains, Inc
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): 'Jack Wang', director of a Milpitas, CA drivetrain maker on its 2016-2017 Form Ds, predates Project A's Jack Wang (on the team from 2021). No Project A listing or post names the company.

name: Grande West Transportation Group Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): 'John Wang', executive officer of a Canadian bus maker (2020), matched the roster's Jack Wang loosely; a different person, no Project A evidence.

name: Allevion Therapeutics, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): the related person 'Jack Wang', director of an Irvine, CA biotech (2021, 2024), is a US biotech director; Project A's Jack Wang is a London partner who joined in 2021 and invests in European software and defence. No Project A listing, post or press ties the company to the firm.

name: VerifyMe, Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): VerifyMe, Inc. (Lake Mary, FL, a listed company) names a 'Jack Wang' as executive officer on its 2023 Form D; an officer of the issuer, not Project A's London partner, and no Project A listing or post names the company.

name: Noodoe Group Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): 'John Wang', executive officer of a Houston EV-charging company (2023), a different person from Project A's Jack Wang; no Project A listing or post names the company.

name: Statics Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): 'Johnny Wang', executive officer of a Laguna Beach company (2024), a different person from Project A's Jack Wang; no Project A listing or post names the company.

name: Digitail Inc.
notes: not_member (agent-judge-pro102): Form D name-match only (D7): Andreas Helbig is a director on Digitail's 2025 Form D; he appears on Project A's team pages only in 2020, so a 2025 seat is dated outside his tenure (T4, seat dating). No Project A listing, post or press names Digitail.

name: Kfzteile24
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): EQT Mid Market bought the majority from the founders (announced 2015-10-05, completed Dec 2015); Project A joined EQT's position with a seven-figure co-investment in March 2016 ('With its seven-figure investment Project A joins the EQT Mid Market Fund', eu-startups), and in April 2023 was part of the management buy-out consortium that bought kfzteile24 from EQT. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Onlineprinters
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Bregal Unternehmerkapital completed a majority buyout in early October 2016; Project A put a seven-figure sum into a minority stake beside Bregal in November 2016, its 'second private equity co-investment' (VC Magazin). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Lampenwelt
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): The same company as luqom-group (Lampenwelt, now LUQOM Group): 3i bought the majority in March 2017 and Project A agreed with 3i to invest in October 2017, 'the third private equity co-investment' (Private Equity News); 3i still holds the majority. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3); the merge into luqom-group cannot run because that row is excluded.

name: Trendtours
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Bregal Unternehmerkapital bought trendtours from its founder as a succession arrangement in October 2018; Project A Services GmbH & Co. KG joined weeks later as an operational co-investor (VC Magazin, 2018-11-21); the firm's own archived record reads 'Succession Arrangement', 'PE Co-Investment'. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Amann Girrbach
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Capvis has held the majority since April 2018; Project A's May 2020 investment in the Capvis portfolio company (Capvis's own release) is recorded by the firm as a 'PE Co-Investment', 'Later Stage Acceleration' (the archived Contentful record): a stake beside the controlling sponsor. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: GartenHaus
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): The same company as ydeon-group (A-Z Gartenhaus, renamed YDEON Group): 3i agreed in September 2020 to buy the majority, and Project A's October 2020 investment 'was made as a co-investment with the private equity firm 3i Group' (Deutsche Startups dealmonitor). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3); the merge into ydeon-group cannot run because that row is excluded.

name: Inwerk
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Triton completed a majority acquisition of Inwerk on 2020-12-23; Project A invested in the Triton-controlled company in May 2021, recorded by the firm as a 'PE Co-Investment' (the archived Contentful record). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Luqom Group
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): 3i bought the majority of Lampenwelt in March 2017; Project A agreed with 3i to invest in October 2017, 'the third private equity co-investment' (Private Equity News). 3i still holds the majority of LUQOM Group. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Perfect Drive Sports Group
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): The same company as the CMS row PDSG, listed 2021-2024 under its full name: Bregal holds the majority and Project A's July 2021 stake was a PE co-investment beside it (YPOG). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: WindStar Medical
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Oakley Capital bought WindStar Medical from ProSiebenSat.1's NuCom in October 2020, and Project A invested together with Oakley in December 2020 (FYB); the Merz Group took the majority of the combined holding in 2024. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Konges Sløjd
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): 3i bought the majority from the founder in June-August 2022 (FIH Partners); Project A's 2022 position, from Fund IV, is recorded by the firm as private_equity (live CMS) and 'PE Co-Investment' (archived record), a stake beside 3i. No public source names Project A in the deal. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: NWT
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): KLAR Partners' funds invested in NWT Group in 2022 with the founders re-investing after selling ('rückbeteiligt', M&A Review); Project A's November 2022 co-investment 'joins KLAR Partners as a growth partner' (YPOG). KLAR's stake is not stated; the firm records the position as private_equity. Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: YDEON Group
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): 3i agreed in September 2020 to buy a majority of A-Z Gartenhaus (renamed YDEON); Project A's October 2020 investment 'was made as a co-investment with the private equity firm 3i Group' (Deutsche Startups dealmonitor). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: PDSG
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Bregal Unternehmerkapital bought the majority of Perfect Drive Sports Group (All4Golf, Clubhouse Golf) in March 2021; Project A's July 2021 investment was a PE co-investment beside Bregal (YPOG). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).

name: Primutec
notes: control_position (agent-judge-pro102): Held by the firm's 'Buyout Fund I' (live CMS), a buyout-strategy vehicle (strategy desks, T1); Trill Impact took the majority in May 2025. Project A's PE practice describes itself as a partner for 'Management teams looking for an active majority partner' (project-a.pe). Control position (decisions.md D3, R1; COLLECTION.md s1 T3).
